logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Supporting illustration for the B verification memo, WO-03 compute node package selection, round 3. Depict a two-panel verification view on a shared acceptance-batch basis. Left panel: an eligibility gate checklist table for the four candidates with recomputed values — P4 (quality 98, defects 2), P3 (97, 4), P2 (95, 0), P1 (87, 0) — each row marked as passing both gates (quality ≥80, defects ≤5), with the tightest margin highlighted: P3's 4-of-5 defect ceiling. Right panel: a horizontal energy ladder in Wh per fixed compute acceptance batch, bars ordered P3 10 Wh (shortest, green), P2 22 Wh, P1 28 Wh, P4 49 Wh (longest), with gap annotations +12 Wh (P2), +18 Wh (P1) and +39 Wh (P4) above the minimum, and consecutive spacing 12/6/21 Wh noted. End the flow with the verified decision: P3 selected, P2 at 22 Wh as the regrade fallback if P3's defect count worsens by two or more. Style: clean technical infographic, muted engineering palette, serif labels, no decorative content — every element traces to the trusted source table.
